title: Aku di Bawah dan Kamu di Atas #1
comment: The first part of Aku di Bawah dan Kamu di Atas, 4 four-part zine combining black-and-white photography, personal writings, and short poems.  Prasetya Yudha is a publisher and photo editor based in Yogyakarta. He is also co-initiator of a photography-focused publishing platform called SOKONG!
